algorithm.representation: Boolean factor-tree CSP with local relation Q_e={0,1}^3\{minority-only, both-majorities-only}
algorithm.synthesis: bottom-up Boolean messages plus one backtrack
algorithm.selector_from_mask: if minority is flipped, choose a flipped majority; otherwise choose deterministic majority

ceiling: Acyclicity is sufficient but not necessary; cyclic degree-3 linear NAE remains polynomial, so cycle presence alone is not the missing hardness motif.
